notes: A UCP-Native deposit_required checkout with a fixed deposit. The business returns the full checkout total, exactly one selected term, one immediate schedule for the deposit, and a balance due at slot start. complete_checkout collects only the immediate amount. The order carries the same accepted term. Platforms MUST NOT compute the deposit from catalog.pricing.deposit and MUST NOT send split_payments.
